parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with very deep S waves in V2-V3 and very tall R waves in V4-V5 (voltage far above the Sokolow-Lyon threshold). The mild ST elevation in V1-V3 is a discordant, LVH-related pattern with no reciprocal changes or regional ST elevation, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
